calendar_auto_scroll.issue: Calendar does not auto-scroll to center on today
calendar_auto_scroll.root_cause: The useEffect at line 120-133 in ProSpace.tsx calls scrollRef.current.scrollTo() but the scroll doesn't happen. Possible causes: 1) scrollRef.current is null when doScroll() runs, 2) The 80ms timeout is not enough for the DOM to be ready, 3) The scrollTo() method is not working with the current CSS styles
reproduction_steps: 3. Observe calendar shows days 1-7 instead of days around 25 (today)
4. Check scrollLeft value - it's 0 instead of ~1148
calendar_auto_scroll.mitigation: Increase timeout from 80ms to 200ms, or use requestAnimationFrame, or check if scrollRef.current exists before calling scrollTo
